headline: Former Nurse's Quick Action Saves Baby's Life at Post Office
meta_description: A former nurse working as a postal clerk in Clifton, Arizona, sprang into action when an 8-month-old baby stopped breathing, sparking a lifelong bond between f…
summary_short: A former nurse turned postal clerk saved an 8-month-old baby who stopped breathing at a Clifton, Arizona post office, and the two families remain close.
body:
A former nurse working as a postal clerk saved an 8-month-old baby who stopped breathing inside a Clifton, Arizona post office. The quick-thinking employee's medical background and presence of mind made the difference in a moment that could have ended tragically.

The incident created an unexpected bond between the families. As the baby underwent medical treatment to address the underlying condition, both families stayed connected, their relationship deepening through the child's recovery journey. What began as a crisis at the post office counter became a testament to how one person's skills and compassion can change everything.
quick_facts: Former nurse, now postal clerk in Clifton, Arizona
8-month-old baby stopped breathing at post office
Two families remain close after the incident
Baby received medical care for the condition
